200.body: Witness testifies Polish president discussed “making money bringing girls” to hotel where they worked 20 years ago Oct 27, 2026 | Law , Politics Keep our news free from ads and paywalls by making a donation to support our work! A former colleague of Polish President Karol Nawrocki from when he worked as a security guard in a hotel two decades ago testified in court that he told her it was possible to “make some extra money by bringing in girls”. It claimed, based on information provided by unnamed former colleagues of the future president, that he had “participated in bringing prostitutes for guests of the Grand Hotel in Sopot while working there as a security guard” almost 20 years earlier.

200.title: Poland did not allow Ukrainian apples into the EU because they exceeded pesticide limits
200.summary: News World Poland did not allow Ukrainian apples into the EU because they exceeded pesticide limits UA NEWS 28 October 2026 08:38 --> Polish regulatory authorities have detained a shipment of fresh apples from Ukraine due to pesticide residue levels exceeding permissible limits.
200.body: News World Poland did not allow Ukrainian apples into the EU because they exceeded pesticide limits UA NEWS 28 October 2026 08:38 --> Polish regulatory authorities have detained a shipment of fresh apples from Ukraine due to pesticide residue levels exceeding permissible limits. Based on the inspection results, the regulatory authorities decided to return the entire shipment of apples to the Ukrainian shipper, preventing it from entering the European Union market. Poland is one of the key players in the European apple market and remains the largest producer of this product in the European Union. This incident highlights the importance of complying with EU requirements regarding pesticide residues when exporting Ukrainian agricultural products to the European market.

300.title: Why China, Chile, France and Poland lost nearly a million tonnes of fresh apple exports
300.summary: Blogs Exclusive Horticulture market News Trending Why China, Chile, France and Poland lost nearly a million tonnes of fresh apple exports by Andriy Yarmak 28 Oct 26 0 81 As the global fresh apple market shrinks, some countries inevitably lose ground.
300.body: Blogs Exclusive Horticulture market News Trending Why China, Chile, France and Poland lost nearly a million tonnes of fresh apple exports by Andriy Yarmak 28 Oct 26 0 81 As the global fresh apple market shrinks, some countries inevitably lose ground. Four countries in focus account for the largest absolute reductions: China lost approximately 346,000 tonnes, Chile 222,000 tonnes, France 180,000 tonnes and Poland 148,000 tonnes of their fresh apple exports. Fresh apple exports from China declined from approximately 1.26 million tonnes in 2016–2018 to 913,000 tonnes in 2023–2025 – a loss of 346,000 tonnes, or 27.5%. Average annual fresh apple exports fell from approximately 753,000 to 532,000 tonnes, a reduction of 222,000 tonnes, or 29.4%.

500.title: Oracle adds Google TPUs to OCI to expand enterprise AI compute options
500.summary: Oracle has entered into a partnership with Google to bring the latter’s Tensor Processing Units (TPUs) to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), giving its enterprise customers an alternative to GPUs for training and inference workloads without running their workloads on Google’s own cloud platform.
500.body: Oracle has entered into a partnership with Google to bring the latter’s Tensor Processing Units (TPUs) to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), giving its enterprise customers an alternative to GPUs for training and inference workloads without running their workloads on Google’s own cloud platform. The deal, which was announced at Oracle AI World in Las Vegas on Tuesday, marks the first time Google TPUs will be available through another hyperscaler, the companies said in a joint statement. The addition of TPUs will expand Oracle customers’ compute portfolio as they look for alternatives to GPUs to manage the rising costs and infrastructure demands of training large AI models and running inference at scale, said Stephanie Walter, practice leader of AI stack at HyperFrame Research. Typically, Google’s TPUs are intended for machine learning workloads, including large-model training, post-training, and inference.
